senses.sense_definition: Het leren kennen van iets of iemand, meestal tijdens een eerste ontmoeting.

examples.text: Hun <w>kennismaking</w> kwam min of meer toevallig tot stand.

target_lang_translations.en: Their <w>meeting</w> came about more or less by chance.
target_lang_translations.ru: Их <w>знакомство</w> произошло более или менее случайно.
target_lang_translations.it: La loro <w>conoscenza</w> è avvenuta più o meno per caso.

examples.text: De <w>kennismaking</w> met mijn nieuwe collega's verliep erg soepel en prettig.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>introduction</w> to my new colleagues went very smoothly and pleasantly.
target_lang_translations.ru: <w>Знакомство</w> с моими новыми коллегами прошло очень гладко и приятно.
target_lang_translations.it: La <w>presentazione</w> ai miei nuovi colleghi è andata molto bene e piacevolmente.

target_lang_definitions.en: The process of getting to know someone or something, usually during a first meeting.
target_lang_definitions.ru: Процесс знакомства с кем-то или чем-то, обычно во время первой встречи.
target_lang_definitions.it: Il processo di conoscere qualcuno o qualcosa, solitamente durante un primo incontro.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: act of meeting for the first time
process of getting to know someone

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: l'atto di fare la conoscenza di qualcuno
l'atto di presentarsi o essere presentati
